title: Fund a test task yourself, from the faucet
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Ask the faucet for test USDC, install the workflow in a repository you own, and fund one issue there with `/knos fund 5`.
evidence: a funded job or work order on Solana devnet in a repository that is not Knos's, funded by your account or wallet (scripts/outsiders.py funder_of says outside)
counted_when: the account that did it is not one of Knos's own (scripts/own_github_ids.json); shown as "on tasks Knos funded itself"
